claims.statement: EU F-gas Regulation 2024/573 applies from March 2024 to covered gases and equipment relying on them.
The Commission describes stricter emission-prevention rules spanning installation, servicing and disposal.

economics.acquisition_route: Recruit technicians through wholesalers and route initial demand from installers and property managers
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Unvalidated: 3000 monthly jobs could produce about 3m PLN annual platform revenue; multi-country density could support more than 5m PLN founder equity in years 5-7
economics.gross_margin_basis: Unvalidated: 60-75% after credential checks, support and payment costs
economics.payback: Unvalidated: 9-15 months at roughly 250 completed jobs/month
economics.pricing: Unvalidated: 60-180 PLN booking fee or 8-12% of labour value
economics.retention_or_repeat: Recurring seasonal installation, inspection and maintenance slots

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Availability, completion and defect data create a trusted capacity graph that is hard for generic lead marketplaces to copy
fingerprint.customer: HVAC distributors, heat-pump sellers and multi-site facility operators
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Wholesaler integrations, installer associations and the founder family's installation network
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Credential-checked capacity calendar with scoped work orders, escrowed documentation and repeat service plans
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: Buyer pays a booking fee and transaction commission when a verified technician accepts a slot
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A sold unit or required service cannot proceed because qualified field capacity is unavailable

founder_fit: Scheduling and risk scoring use data skills

structure.control_point: real-time verified technician availability and performance record
structure.critical_dependency: Credential verification and contractor allocation must comply with national F-gas implementation and labour rules

thesis: Let HVAC distributors and facility operators reserve verified Polish/EU technician capacity for regulated installation, leak checks and recovery work, without employing their own crews.
title: Certified F-Gas Technician Slot Exchange
uncertainties: Buyer willingness, take rate and job frequency are unvalidated
Usable credential data access in Poland is unconfirmed
